reviews.title: I need to find another app
reviews.text: This app is annoying because every time I open it to check prayer times, it shows me an ad. Like seriously, profiting off of a prayer app? Moreover, I’ve had to turn notifications off because if I want to be notified of prayer times via the athan, I will also receive other notifications from the app like the app advertising their Quran academy, or things like “track your prayers” or “Zhuhr is the time that gates to heaven are opened.” It’s annoying. I don’t want these notifications so unfortunately I also have to manually check prayer times, and when I do that, I’m faced with an app. Like every time. Will be searching for a different app.

reviews.title: Recent update has made the app much harder to use
reviews.text:
I’ve been a paying subscriber and previously really liked this app, but the recent changes have significantly worsened the user experience.

The new bottom navigation is transparent, making the buttons difficult to see as you move between screens.

More frustratingly, when reading the Quran there is now a persistent promotional banner encouraging you to improve your recitation/pronunciation. It sits where I naturally expect the navigation to be, so I accidentally click it all the time and am taken to a page promoting another app/service.

I pay for a subscription precisely because I don’t want advertising or promotional content interfering with my use of the app. This feels particularly intrusive in the Quran reader, which should be one of the calmest and least cluttered parts of an Islamic app.

I really hope these changes are reconsidered. Until then, I would hesitate to recommend paying for a subscription.

reviews.title: Honest Review
reviews.text: Honestly I used to do such a good job at keeping up with prayer exactly on time when I followed the Muslim pro app but then I started hearing rumors about how that app wasn’t accurate so I deleted it and downloaded this app. This app gives you a billion ads and I always skipped the ad so I can just get the prayer time and then as soon as I skipped the add, i would be on the prayer time portion for like 5 seconds and then another ad pops up. It was soooo frustrating but what’s even more frustration now is that it takes forever to load. I press the prayer times page so many times and it doesn’t load, then it will glitch and take me out the app and I’ll have to redo it all over again so I started to go less and less to look at exact prayer times and started guessing, astaghfirullah - may Allah forgive me.  I need to find a better app to help me get back on the rhythm of praying on time. If anyone has any suggestions, please let me know and may Allah reward you.

reviews.title: Unusable
reviews.text: If I could give 0 stars, I sadly would. I have been a loyal user of this app for almost a decade. However, the latest updates have degraded the app severely and it can no longer be used. If I open the app, it stalls on the logo screen for minutes on end, crashes without rebooting, and when it does finally open, lags for at least a full minute or two before it can be used. Also, the amount of ads on the free version make it impossible to properly use app features such as the Quran or Qibla finder. As I am writing this, I have been trying to open the app for more than 15 minutes and it still will not load. I am extremely disappointed with how this app has been handled and am saddened by the fact that I can no longer use it myself.

reviews.title: V3.0 several steps backward/Intrusive Ads
reviews.text:
Version 3.0 will find favour only among those unacquainted w/ earlier versions. Gone are many good features (24 hr clock, different versions of Adzhan, easily identiified cities).  V3.0 has a prayer log useful only for students and youth. This is a prayer site. Who needs a mandatory Facebook link? GPS masjid locator is not all inclusive nor up-to-date. Sooo much was lost on this "upgrade." If it ain't broke.... If you've used earlier versions of IslamicFinder, avoid this one like the plague. Now in 2026 I find my screens being interrupted every 30 seconds for annoying advertising “install this…” or “sign up for…”. 
Better and free versions are available in the App store.
